blocks.text: Gapda ikki fe'l ketma-ket kelsa (I want ... go, I enjoy ... read), ikkinchisi yo **to + fe'l** (I want **to go**), yo **-ing** shaklida (I enjoy **reading**) bo'ladi. Qaysi biri bo'lishini **birinchi fe'l** hal qiladi. O'zbek tilida ham shunday: «suzish**ni** yaxshi ko'raman», «ketish**ga** qaror qildim», «gapirish**dan** to'xtadi» — har bir fe'l o'z qo'shimchasini talab qiladi. Inglizchada qo'shimcha o'rniga ikki variant bor: **to** yoki **-ing**. Bu dars — qaysi fe'ldan keyin qaysi biri kelishi haqida.
1. Fe'l + to: want to, decide to, hope to

Bu fe'llarning ko'pi **kelajakka qaragan**: istak, reja, qaror, va'da, urinish — ish hali bajarilmagan. **to** go'yo «tomon» ma'nosini saqlab qolgan: I decided **to go** — «borish tomon» qaror qildim. O'zbekchada ular ko'pincha «-moqchi», «-ishga», «-ishni» bilan beriladi. **to** dan keyin har doim fe'lning asosiy shakli turadi (51-dars): to **go**, to **buy** — «to going» yoki «to went» emas.

items.text: Bekzod **decided to sell** his old car.
We **hope to see** you again soon.
items.translation: Sizni tez orada yana **ko'rishga umid qilamiz**.

blocks.text: 2. Fe'l + -ing: enjoy, finish, stop, mind, suggest

Bu fe'llardan keyin faqat **-ing** keladi, **to** — hech qachon. Ularning ko'pi **harakatning o'zi** haqida: undan zavq olish (enjoy), uni tugatish (finish), to'xtatish (stop), unga qarshi bo'lmaslik (mind), uni taklif qilish (suggest). -ing shakli bu yerda o'zbekchadagi «-ish» otiga juda o'xshaydi: reading — o'qish, cooking — ovqat pishirish. I enjoy **cooking** — «Ovqat pishirish menga yoqadi».

items.text: My son **has finished reading** the whole book.

blocks.text: **Do you mind ...?** / **Would you mind ...?** + -ing — xushmuomala iltimos: Would you **mind closing** the door? — «Eshikni yopib qo'ysangiz, qarshi emasmisiz?» Rozilik javobi — **No, not at all.** («Yo'q, qarshi emasman» = «Bemalol»). Ehtiyot bo'ling: «Yes» desangiz, «ha, qarshiman» degan ma'no chiqadi.
3. Ikkalasi ham: like, love, hate, start, begin, continue, prefer

Bu fe'llardan keyin **to** ham, **-ing** ham kelishi mumkin va ma'no deyarli farq qilmaydi: It **started to rain** = It **started raining**. I **like swimming** = I **like to swim**. Britaniyada **like / love / hate + -ing** ko'proq «umuman yoqadi» ma'nosida ishlatiladi (I **love cooking**), **like + to** esa ko'pincha odat yoki «shunday qilgan ma'qul» ma'nosida: I **like to get up** early — «Erta turishni ma'qul ko'raman».

items.translation: Qizim hayvonlar **rasmini chizishni juda yaxshi ko'radi**.

blocks.text: **would** bilan kelgan shakllar — **would like**, **would love**, **would prefer**, **would hate** — doim **to** bilan: I**'d like to** go, I**'d love to** come. Ma'nosi ham farq qiladi: I **like dancing** — umuman raqs tushishni yaxshi ko'raman (doimiy did); I**'d like to dance** — hozir yoki aniq bir vaziyatda raqs tushmoqchiman (bir martalik istak). Javobda fe'l takrorlanmasligi mumkin: **I'd love to!** — «Jonim bilan!». would like haqida batafsil — 34-dars.

items.text: I **like dancing**, and tonight I**'d like to dance** with you.
items.translation: Raqs tushishni **yaxshi ko'raman**, bugun kechqurun siz bilan **raqs tushmoqchiman**.

items.text: **Would** you **like to come** with us? — I**'d love to**!

blocks.text: Ikkinchi fe'lni inkor qilish uchun undan oldin **not** qo'yiladi: I decided **not to go** — «bormaslikka qaror qildim»; Try **not to be** late — «kechikmaslikka harakat qiling»; I enjoy **not working** on Sundays. Birinchi fe'lni inkor qilish esa odatdagidek — do / does / did bilan: I **didn't decide** to go — «borishga qaror qilmadim». Ma'no butunlay boshqa, shuning uchun not qayerda turganiga e'tibor bering.

items.text: We **decided not to buy** the house.
**Try not to forget** your keys again.

blocks.text: O'zbek tilida ikkinchi fe'l deyarli doim «-ish» otiga aylanadi, birinchi fe'l esa unga kelishik qo'shimchasini qo'shadi: o'qish**ni** yaxshi ko'raman, ketish**ga** qaror qildim. Inglizchadagi tanlov (to yoki -ing) bu qo'shimchalarga mos kelmaydi: «-ishga qaror qildim» — **to** (decided to go), «-ishni tugatdim» — **-ing** (finished writing). Shuning uchun o'zbekchadan tarjima qilib emas, inglizcha fe'lni o'z qolipi bilan birga yodlang: **enjoy + -ing**, **decide + to**.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I enjoy to read.» → **I enjoy reading.**; «I want going.» → **I want to go.**; «I finished to write.» → **I finished writing.**; «She suggested to go.» → **She suggested going.**; «Do you mind to wait?» → **Do you mind waiting?**; «I decided go.» → **I decided to go.** (to tushib qolmasin); «I'd like going.» → **I'd like to go.**

Eslab qolish: **to** — oldinga qaragan fe'llar (want, hope, plan, decide, promise — ish hali bo'lmagan). **-ing** — mavjud harakatga munosabat (enjoy, mind, finish, stop — harakat bor, biz uni yoqtiramiz, tugatamiz yoki to'xtatamiz). Bu 100% qoida emas, lekin ko'p fe'lni eslab qolishga yordam beradi. **stop** dan keyin to kelsa, ma'no o'zgaradi: He **stopped smoking** — chekishni tashladi; He **stopped to smoke** — chekish **uchun** to'xtadi (maqsad — 54-dars).

examples.title: **want to**, **hope to**, **plan to**: wishes and plans
examples.description: Istak va rejalar haqidagi fe'llardan keyin to + fe'l: want, need, hope, plan, expect. Ish hali bo'lmagan — kelajakka qaragan.

sentences.text: I **want to visit** my grandparents this weekend.
sentences.translation: Bu dam olish kunlari bobom va buvimni **ko'rgani bormoqchiman**.

sentences.text: Madina **hopes to become** a doctor one day.
sentences.translation: Madina bir kun kelib shifokor **bo'lishga umid qiladi**.

sentences.text: We**'re planning to open** a small café in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Biz Buxoroda kichik kafe **ochishni rejalashtiryapmiz**.

sentences.text: Do you **need to leave** right now?
sentences.translation: Hoziroq **ketishingiz kerakmi**?

sentences.text: Tom **expects to finish** the project by Friday.
sentences.translation: Tom loyihani jumagacha **tugataman deb o'ylayapti**.

sentences.text: After school my son **wants to study** in Oxford.
sentences.translation: Maktabni bitirgach o'g'lim Oksfordda **o'qimoqchi**.

sentences.text: Nobody **wants to work** on Sunday, but someone has to.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kuni hech kim **ishlashni xohlamaydi**, lekin kimdir ishlashi kerak.

sentences.text: How much money **do** you **need to save** for a new car?
sentences.translation: Yangi mashina uchun qancha pul **yig'ishingiz kerak**?

sentences.text: Bekzod and Lola **plan to get** married next spring.
sentences.translation: Bekzod va Lola kelasi bahorda **turmush qurishni rejalashtirishyapti**.

sentences.text: Sarah **didn't want to stay** at home, so she went for a walk.
sentences.translation: Sara uyda **qolishni xohlamadi**, shuning uchun sayrga chiqdi.

examples.title: **decide to**, **promise to**, **forget to**, **learn to**
examples.description: Qaror, va'da, urinish va o'rganish fe'llari ham to bilan: decide, promise, offer, refuse, try, learn, forget.

sentences.text: Finally we **decided to buy** the blue sofa.
sentences.translation: Nihoyat ko'k divanni **sotib olishga qaror qildik**.

sentences.text: Aziz **promised to help** me with my homework.
sentences.translation: Aziz uy vazifamga **yordam berishga va'da berdi**.

sentences.text: Oh no, I **forgot to turn off** the oven!
sentences.translation: Voy, duxovkani **o'chirishni unutibman**!

sentences.text: My grandmother **learnt to read** when she was sixty.
sentences.translation: Buvim oltmish yoshida **o'qishni o'rgangan**.

sentences.text: James **offered to drive** us to the airport.
sentences.translation: Jeyms bizni aeroportga **olib borishni taklif qildi**.

sentences.text: The shop assistant **refused to give** me my money back.
sentences.translation: Sotuvchi pulimni **qaytarib berishdan bosh tortdi**.

sentences.text: Please **try to be** on time tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, ertaga **kechikmaslikka harakat qiling**.

sentences.text: Why **did** you **decide to leave** your job?
sentences.translation: Nega ishingizdan **ketishga qaror qildingiz**?

sentences.text: Don't **forget to send** me the photos from the wedding.
sentences.translation: To'ydagi suratlarni menga **yuborishni unutmang**.

sentences.text: When I was a child, I **learnt to swim** in the river near our village.
sentences.translation: Bolaligimda qishlog'imiz yaqinidagi daryoda **suzishni o'rganganman**.

examples.title: **enjoy**, **finish**, **stop** + **-ing**
examples.description: Bu fe'llardan keyin ikkinchi fe'l faqat -ing shaklida: enjoy reading, finish eating, stop talking. to qo'yilmaydi.

sentences.text: I really **enjoy cooking** for my friends.
sentences.translation: Do'stlarimga **ovqat pishirish** menga juda **yoqadi**.

sentences.text: Has it **stopped raining** yet?
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir **tindimi**?

sentences.text: Emma **finished writing** her essay at midnight.
sentences.translation: Emma inshosini yarim tunda **yozib tugatdi**.

sentences.text: My father **stopped smoking** five years ago.
sentences.translation: Dadam besh yil oldin **chekishni tashlagan**.

sentences.text: Did you **enjoy staying** at that hotel in Samarkand?
sentences.translation: Samarqanddagi o'sha mehmonxonada **turish** sizga **yoqdimi**?

sentences.text: The children **don't enjoy doing** homework at the weekend.
sentences.translation: Bolalarga dam olish kunlari **uy vazifasi qilish yoqmaydi**.

sentences.text: When you **finish eating**, please wash your plate.
sentences.translation: **Ovqatlanib bo'lgach**, likopchangizni yuving.

sentences.text: Suddenly everybody **stopped talking** and looked at the door.
sentences.translation: Birdan hamma **gapirishdan to'xtadi** va eshikka qaradi.

sentences.text: Bekzod **enjoys playing** football more than watching it.
sentences.translation: Bekzodga futbolni tomosha qilishdan ko'ra **o'ynash** ko'proq **yoqadi**.

sentences.text: After two hours the workers **finished painting** the kitchen walls.
sentences.translation: Ikki soatdan keyin ishchilar oshxona devorlarini **bo'yab bo'lishdi**.

examples.title: **mind**, **suggest**, **avoid**, **keep** + **-ing**
examples.description: -ing talab qiladigan yana bir guruh: mind, suggest, avoid, keep, practise, give up. «Do / Would you mind + -ing?» — xushmuomala iltimos.

sentences.text: **Do** you **mind waiting** a few minutes? — No, not at all.
sentences.translation: Bir necha daqiqa **kutib tursangiz maylimi**? — Bemalol.

sentences.text: I **don't mind working** late on Fridays.
sentences.translation: Juma kunlari kechgacha **ishlashga qarshi emasman**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **suggested going** to the cinema after dinner.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza kechki ovqatdan keyin kinoga **borishni taklif qildi**.

sentences.text: You should **avoid eating** too much sugar.
sentences.translation: Juda ko'p shakar **yeyishdan saqlanishingiz kerak**.

sentences.text: My neighbour's dog **keeps barking** all night.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnimning iti tun bo'yi **tinmay vovullaydi**.

sentences.text: **Would** you **mind closing** the door, please?
sentences.translation: Eshikni **yopib qo'ysangiz maylimi**?

sentences.text: Our teacher says we should **practise speaking** English every day.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchimiz har kuni inglizcha **gapirishni mashq qilishimiz** kerakligini aytadi.

sentences.text: James **gave up eating** meat two years ago.
sentences.translation: Jeyms ikki yil oldin go'sht **yeyishni tashladi**.

sentences.text: Why **do** you **keep asking** me the same question?
sentences.translation: Nega menga bir xil savolni **qayta-qayta beryapsiz**?

sentences.text: Sarah **suggested taking** the train because the roads were busy.
sentences.translation: Yo'llar gavjum bo'lgani uchun Sara poyezdda **borishni taklif qildi**.

examples.title: **like**, **love**, **start**, **begin**: **to** or **-ing**
examples.description: Bu fe'llardan keyin ikkalasi ham mumkin, ma'no deyarli bir xil: like swimming = like to swim; start raining = start to rain.

sentences.text: Do you **like swimming** in the sea? — Yes, I love it.
sentences.translation: Dengizda **suzishni yaxshi ko'rasizmi**? — Ha, juda.

sentences.text: It **started to rain** when we got to the park.
sentences.translation: Parkka yetib kelganimizda yomg'ir **yog'a boshladi**.

sentences.text: Aziz **loves telling** funny stories about his childhood.
sentences.translation: Aziz bolaligi haqida kulgili voqealarni **aytib berishni juda yaxshi ko'radi**.

sentences.text: My mother **hates to be** late for anything.
sentences.translation: Onam hech narsaga **kechikishni yomon ko'radi**.

sentences.text: The baby **began to cry** in the middle of the night.
sentences.translation: Yarim tunda chaqaloq **yig'lay boshladi**.

sentences.text: When **did** you **start learning** English?
sentences.translation: Ingliz tilini qachon **o'rgana boshladingiz**?

sentences.text: Emma **prefers to travel** by train, not by plane.
sentences.translation: Emma samolyotda emas, poyezdda **yurishni afzal ko'radi**.

sentences.text: The band **continued playing** for another hour in the rain.
sentences.translation: Musiqachilar yomg'irda yana bir soat **chalishda davom etishdi**.

sentences.text: I **don't like getting up** early, but I **like to have** time for breakfast.
sentences.translation: Erta **turishni yoqtirmayman**, lekin nonushtaga vaqtim **bo'lishini ma'qul ko'raman**.

sentences.text: In Bukhara people **begin preparing** for Navruz weeks before the holiday.
sentences.translation: Buxoroda odamlar Navro'zga bayramdan bir necha hafta oldin **tayyorlana boshlashadi**.

examples.title: **I like** -ing or **I'd like to** ...?
examples.description: like + -ing — umuman yoqadi (doimiy); would like + to — hozir xohlayman (bir martalik istak). would love, would prefer, would hate ham doim to bilan.

sentences.text: Do you **like going** to the theatre?
sentences.translation: Teatrga **borishni yoqtirasizmi**?

sentences.text: **Would** you **like to go** to the theatre on Saturday?
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni teatrga **borishni xohlaysizmi**?

sentences.text: My sister **likes cooking**, but tonight she**'d like to eat** out.
sentences.translation: Opam **ovqat pishirishni yaxshi ko'radi**, lekin bugun kechqurun tashqarida **ovqatlanmoqchi**.

sentences.text: I**'d love to see** your new flat.
sentences.translation: Yangi kvartirangizni **ko'rishni juda istardim**.

sentences.text: James **loves travelling**, and one day he**'d love to visit** Uzbekistan.
sentences.translation: Jeyms **sayohat qilishni juda yaxshi ko'radi**, bir kun kelib O'zbekistonga **borishni juda istaydi**.

sentences.text: **Would** you **prefer to sit** by the window? — Yes, please.
sentences.translation: Deraza yonida **o'tirishni afzal ko'rasizmi**? — Ha, iltimos.

sentences.text: Madina **doesn't like flying** because she's afraid of heights.
sentences.translation: Madina **samolyotda uchishni yoqtirmaydi**, chunki u balandlikdan qo'rqadi.

sentences.text: Thank you, I**'d like to pay** by card.
sentences.translation: Rahmat, karta bilan **to'lamoqchiman**.

sentences.text: We **enjoy walking** in the mountains, so next month we**'d like to try** a longer route.
sentences.translation: Biz tog'larda **piyoda yurishni yaxshi ko'ramiz**, shuning uchun kelasi oy uzunroq yo'lni **sinab ko'rmoqchimiz**.

sentences.text: I**'d hate to live** in a big noisy city.
sentences.translation: Katta shovqinli shaharda **yashashni hech istamasdim**.

examples.title: Questions and answers with **to** and **-ing**
examples.description: Savol va qisqa javob: savolda ham ikkinchi fe'l shakli o'zgarmaydi — What do you enjoy **doing**? Did you decide **to** ...?

sentences.text: What **do** you **enjoy doing** in your free time? — I **love drawing**.
sentences.translation: Bo'sh vaqtingizda nima **qilishni yaxshi ko'rasiz**? — **Rasm chizishni** juda yaxshi ko'raman.

sentences.text: **Have** you **finished cleaning** your room? — Not yet, sorry.
sentences.translation: Xonangizni **yig'ishtirib bo'ldingizmi**? — Hali yo'q, kechirasiz.

sentences.text: **Did** Aziz **agree to help** us? — Yes, he did.
sentences.translation: Aziz bizga **yordam berishga rozi bo'ldimi**? — Ha, rozi bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Where **are** you **planning to spend** your holiday? — In Turkey, probably.
sentences.translation: Ta'tilni qayerda **o'tkazishni rejalashtiryapsiz**? — Turkiyada, ehtimol.

sentences.text: Why **did** Sarah **stop going** to the gym? — She was too busy.
sentences.translation: Nega Sara sport zaliga **borishni to'xtatdi**? — U juda band edi.

sentences.text: **Does** your son **want to be** a pilot? — No, he wants to be an engineer.
sentences.translation: O'g'lingiz uchuvchi **bo'lishni xohlaydimi**? — Yo'q, u muhandis bo'lmoqchi.

sentences.text: When **did** it **start snowing**? — Early this morning.
sentences.translation: Qor qachon **yog'a boshladi**? — Bugun erta tongda.

sentences.text: **Would** you **like to join** us for lunch? — I'd love to, thanks!
sentences.translation: Biz bilan **tushlik qilishni xohlaysizmi**? — Jonim bilan, rahmat!

sentences.text: Who **suggested inviting** James? — Madina did.
sentences.translation: Jeymsni **taklif qilishni** kim **maslahat berdi**? — Madina.

sentences.text: **Did** you **manage to find** a parking space? — Yes, but it took ages.
sentences.translation: Mashina qo'yishga joy **topa oldingizmi**? — Ha, lekin juda uzoq qidirdim.

examples.title: Dialogue: hobbies and plans
examples.description: Suhbatda to va -ing aralash: enjoy -ing, learn to, give up -ing, hope to, forget to, promise to.

sentences.text: — What **do** you **like doing** after work, Emma?
sentences.translation: — Ishdan keyin nima **qilishni yaxshi ko'rasan**, Emma?

sentences.text: — I **enjoy running** in the park, and I**'m learning to play** the guitar.
sentences.translation: — Parkda **yugurish** menga **yoqadi**, yana gitara **chalishni o'rganyapman**.

sentences.text: — Really? Last year I **tried to learn** the guitar, but I **gave up practising** after a month.
sentences.translation: — Rostdanmi? O'tgan yili men ham gitarani **o'rganishga harakat qildim**, lekin bir oydan keyin **mashq qilishni tashladim**.

sentences.text: — Why? Did you **stop enjoying** it?
sentences.translation: — Nega? **Yoqmay qoldimi**?

sentences.text: — No, I just **didn't want to practise** every evening.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, shunchaki har kuni kechqurun **mashq qilishni xohlamadim**.

sentences.text: — I understand. My teacher **keeps telling** me to practise more.
sentences.translation: — Tushunaman. O'qituvchim ham menga ko'proq mashq qil deb **qayta-qayta aytadi**.

sentences.text: — So **would** you **like to play** something for me one day?
sentences.translation: — Unda bir kun menga biror narsa **chalib bermoqchimisan**?

sentences.text: — Maybe! I **hope to play** at my brother's wedding in May.
sentences.translation: — Balki! May oyida akamning to'yida **chalishga umid qilaman**.

sentences.text: — That sounds great. **Don't forget to invite** me!
sentences.translation: — Zo'r-ku. Meni **taklif qilishni unutma**!

sentences.text: — I **promise to send** you an invitation, don't worry.
sentences.translation: — Senga taklifnoma **yuborishga va'da beraman**, xavotir olma.
